name: Xenios Orders Payments and Fulfillment

outputSha.source: git rev-parse HEAD after the handoff commit
outputSha.note: A commit cannot contain its own SHA. The exact output SHA is returned beside this file.

scope: supplier handoff queue and explicit release
restart-safe workflow hydration and fail-closed snapshot validation
founder-authorized normal order quantities from 1 through 50
hardInvariants: A new workflow can only begin in request_pending with no approval.
Invoice issuance requires a named admin approval.
Payment evidence must match the order invoice and is not payment verification.
Settlement requires committed verification evidence matching the invoice amount and currency.
Supplier handoff requires both approval and committed settlement.
A queued supplier handoff cannot begin fulfillment until a separate named release exists.
Fulfillment requires approval, settlement, and supplier release at both domain and storage layers.
Shipped requires append-only tracking; delivered requires shipped evidence.
Personal and business customer reads are ownership-scoped; business reads also require active organization authority.
Customer timelines omit proof object references, supplier payloads, external transactions, settlements, and internal audit details.
Consequential queue/ask actions require a Trust Dial approval reference; never refuses the action.
Identical idempotency retries replay; changed payloads under the same scoped key conflict and are audited.
Order projection, receipt, timeline, audit, and optional workflow facts form one atomic commit bundle.
Receipt scope and key identities are structurally unambiguous even when either contains colons.
Malformed, duplicate, stale, or internally inconsistent durable snapshots fail closed before reads or commands.
Every request and invoice line quantity is a unique whole-number SKU quantity from 1 through 50; quantity alone creates no review split in that band.
An invoice cannot change the per-SKU quantities in the approved buyer request.
Customer order history is bounded to 1 through 100 items per page and ordered by stable updatedAt/orderId keyset pagination.
Customer history exposes customer-safe price, payment, fulfillment and latest-tracking status without proof, transaction, supplier, or audit data.
A reorder draft carries only source version, owner, SKU and quantity, and requires current catalog, Product Control and pricing validation before any new action.
Reorder preparation never copies invoice, payment, settlement, supplier, fulfillment, tracking, or approval authority.
The read-only database postcheck opens a read-only transaction and always rolls back.
The rollback draft acquires fixed-order ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks on every existing Pack 04 table before any count or drop.
Rollback locks are retained through the transaction, so concurrent inserts cannot commit between the empty-state check and table removal; lock contention fails closed.
The rollback draft is empty-state-only, refuses any Pack 04 row, uses no CASCADE, and does not remove shared extensions or objects.

Eleven end-to-end and adversarial domain tests, including receipt-key collision, quantity 1-through-50, account-history pagination, and ownership isolation coverage.
Unmounted atomic persistence port, normalized transaction bundle, restart hydration, bounded CAS retry, and fail-closed durable-state validation.
Nine restart, concurrency, atomicity, normalization, refusal-audit, retry-exhaustion, quantity-integrity, and corruption tests.
Unrun storage draft with forced RLS, personal/business ownership, customer-scoped timeline RPC, immutable evidence, and non-bypassable workflow gates.

Ten static storage-contract tests protecting RLS, ownership, quantity 1-through-50, approval, settlement, fulfillment, append-only evidence, safe projections, and rollback lock-before-count/drop ordering.
Pack 04 handoff, verification record, and next-gate contract.
Lane-local milestone and safety heartbeat without editing another lane's coordination files.
Concise morning execution record, impact summary, blockers, and exact next actions.
Hash-pinned disposable apply-twice sequence, required behavioral matrix, exact commands, and rollback policy.
Read-only, rollback-always structural, RLS, safe-projection, and founder-quantity postcheck.
Human-reviewed rollback draft that locks every existing Pack 04 table before empty-state inspection, refuses non-empty state, and uses no CASCADE.

independentQaResolution.finding: The rollback counted rows under ACCESS SHARE, allowing a concurrent INSERT to commit before DROP acquired ACCESS EXCLUSIVE.
independentQaResolution.resolution: Acquire all existing Pack 04 table locks in fixed order IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE before the first count and retain them through every drop.
independentQaResolution.verification: Static adversarial coverage proves the canonical table list, lock loop, count loop, and drop phase occur in that order; SQL remains unexecuted.
